_meta.voice: Each summary is written to be spoken almost verbatim: one or two short, warm, concrete sentences.

entries.title: Aries (Mesha)
entries.summary: Ruled by Mars, a fiery cardinal sign. It gives a bold, pioneering, energetic nature - quick to start things, though sometimes impulsive.

entries.title: Taurus (Vrishabha)
entries.summary: Ruled by Venus, a steady earth sign. It brings patience, loyalty, a love of comfort and beauty - dependable, though it can be stubborn.

entries.title: Gemini (Mithuna)
entries.summary: Ruled by Mercury, a curious air sign. It gives a quick, communicative, versatile mind - clever and social, sometimes restless.

entries.title: Cancer (Karka)
entries.summary: Ruled by the Moon, a nurturing water sign. It brings deep feeling, care for family and home, strong intuition - protective, and at times moody.

entries.title: Leo (Simha)
entries.summary: Ruled by the Sun, a proud fire sign. It gives confidence, warmth, generosity and a natural pull toward leadership and being seen.

entries.title: Virgo (Kanya)
entries.summary: Ruled by Mercury, a precise earth sign. It brings a sharp analytical mind, attention to detail and a helpful, service-minded nature.

entries.title: Libra (Tula)
entries.summary: Ruled by Venus, a balanced air sign. It gives charm, diplomacy, a strong sense of fairness and a love of harmony and partnership.

entries.title: Scorpio (Vrishchika)
entries.summary: Ruled by Mars (with Ketu), an intense water sign. It brings depth, passion, secrecy and a powerful capacity for transformation.

entries.title: Sagittarius (Dhanu)
entries.summary: Ruled by Jupiter, an optimistic fire sign. It gives a love of truth, philosophy, travel and freedom - honest, sometimes blunt.

entries.title: Capricorn (Makara)
entries.summary: Ruled by Saturn, a disciplined earth sign. It brings ambition, patience and endurance - a steady climber who earns success slowly and surely.

entries.title: Aquarius (Kumbha)
entries.summary: Ruled by Saturn, an independent air sign. It gives an original, humanitarian, unconventional mind - a thinker who walks their own path.

entries.title: Pisces (Meena)
entries.summary: Ruled by Jupiter, a compassionate water sign. It brings imagination, intuition, gentleness and a spiritual, dreamy nature.

entries.title: Sun (Surya)
entries.summary: The soul, ego and vitality - your father, authority and sense of self. Its dasha (6 years) is a time to step into your own power and be seen.

entries.title: Moon (Chandra)
entries.summary: The mind and emotions - your mother, comfort and inner world. Its dasha (10 years) is a sensitive, nurturing chapter ruled by feeling.

entries.title: Mars (Mangal)
entries.summary: Energy, courage and drive - also siblings and conflict. Its dasha (7 years) is action-packed: great for effort and boldness, mind the temper.

entries.title: Mercury (Budha)
entries.summary: Intellect, communication and commerce. Its dasha (17 years) sharpens the mind and favours learning, trade, writing and clever work.

entries.title: Jupiter (Guru)
entries.summary: Wisdom, growth, fortune and dharma - the great teacher. Its dasha (16 years) is often expansive and blessed: knowledge, faith and opportunity.

entries.title: Venus (Shukra)
entries.summary: Love, beauty, relationships, art and luxury. Its dasha (20 years) is the longest - a chapter of pleasure, comfort and connection.

entries.title: Saturn (Shani)
entries.summary: Discipline, karma, endurance and hard-earned lessons. Its dasha (19 years) tests and matures you - slow, but it builds lasting foundations.

entries.title: Rahu (North Node)
entries.summary: Ambition, obsession, illusion and the unconventional. Its dasha (18 years) can bring sudden rises and foreign or unexpected paths - dazzling but dizzying.

entries.title: Ketu (South Node)
entries.summary: Detachment, spirituality and past-life mastery. Its dasha (7 years) turns you inward - a time of letting go, insight and liberation.

entries.title: Vata dosha
entries.summary: Air and ether - movement, creativity and a quick mind. Balanced it's lively and imaginative; out of balance it shows as anxiety, dryness or restless sleep. Favour warmth, routine and grounding foods.

entries.title: Pitta dosha
entries.summary: Fire and water - metabolism, focus and drive. Balanced it's sharp and courageous; out of balance it shows as anger, acidity or inflammation. Favour cooling foods, calm and moderation.

entries.title: Kapha dosha
entries.summary: Earth and water - structure, calm and stamina. Balanced it's steady and loving; out of balance it shows as lethargy, weight gain or congestion. Favour movement, warmth and light, spiced food.

entries.title: Gaja Kesari Yoga
entries.summary: Formed when Jupiter sits in an angle from the Moon. It grants intelligence, respect, and a lasting good reputation - wisdom that people remember.

entries.title: Raja Yoga
entries.summary: Formed when the lords of an angle and a trine join forces. It's a classic marker of power, success and a rise in status and authority.

entries.title: Viparita Raja Yoga
entries.summary: Formed from the lords of the difficult houses linking up. Its gift is turning setbacks into unexpected triumph - you rise precisely through challenges.

entries.title: Chandra-Mangala Yoga
entries.summary: Formed when the Moon and Mars come together. It gives drive and enterprise, and a knack for building wealth through initiative and effort.

entries.title: Neecha Bhanga Raja Yoga
entries.summary: The cancellation of a planet's debilitation. What looks like a weakness ends up reversing into strength - a humble start that rises to real power.

entries.title: Dasha (planetary period)
entries.summary: In the Vimshottari system, life unfolds in planetary chapters. Whichever planet's dasha is running colours that whole period of your life with its themes.

entries.title: Antardasha (sub-period)
entries.summary: A sub-period inside the larger dasha. It flavours the main chapter - like a chapter within a chapter, blending both planets' energies.

entries.title: Nakshatra (lunar mansion)
entries.summary: One of 27 lunar mansions the Moon travels through. Your birth nakshatra shapes your instincts and deeper personality, beneath the Moon sign.

entries.title: Ascendant (Lagna)
entries.summary: The sign rising on the eastern horizon at your birth. It's your self, body and outward approach to life - the lens the whole chart is read through.

entries.title: Retrograde (Vakri)
entries.summary: When a planet appears to move backward. Its energy turns inward and intensifies - often deep, reflective, and stronger than usual in effect.

entries.title: Agni (digestive fire)
entries.summary: Your digestive and metabolic fire in Ayurveda. Sama agni is balanced; vishama (irregular) is Vata, tikshna (sharp) is Pitta, manda (slow) is Kapha. Strong, steady agni is the root of good health.
